global_caption: The video contains 8 shots. This is a realistic-style extreme sports action short film, using a neutral color palette. The primary visual space consists of a high-altitude environment connecting seaside peaks with forest canyons. Lighting relies on natural daylight and subtle side-backlighting. The first half features controlled and steady camera movement, accelerating rapidly during the jump and fall, then slowing again during the rebound phase.
shot1: Shot 1: Fade in from black, wide overhead composition. Cliff platform located in upper frame, distant sea and mountains layered in background. An elderly male preparing for bungee jumping walks slowly from left edge toward cliff's edge. He appears small within vast surroundings. Wind lifts hem of jacket slightly. Entire scene lit with cool natural light. Camera performs slight forward dolly and downward tilt. Low-frequency ocean waves provide ambient base layer.
shot2: Shot 2: Hard cut from previous shot, medium eye-level framing. Focus on waist harness, chest rise/fall, and slightly trembling fingers. Foreground shows slightly blurred rope. Background features shallow depth-of-field compressed cliff edge. Staff hands quickly tighten straps. Metal clip flashes brief cold light at center frame. Elderly male visibly inhales deeply, shoulders tense then slightly drop. Camera slowly pushes in. Wind becomes more prominent, shifting mood from restraint to tension.
shot3: Shot 3: Action-matched cut from previous shot, extreme close-up side angle. Rough hand firmly grips railing, knuckles whitened from strain. Railing dominates foreground diagonal. Forest canyon in background blurred into dark shapes. Shallow depth-of-field focuses attention on skin texture and micro-tremors. Wind continuously flaps sleeve cuff. Side-backlight accentuates coarse texture of skin and metal edges. Camera nearly static, retaining minimal handheld shake. Moment hand tightens coincides with sudden increase in wind pressure, reinforcing final mental buildup before jump.
shot4: Shot 4: Hard cut from previous shot, medium low-angle framing. Subject stands at cliff edge, horizon lowered. Sky and churning sea dominate background. Jacket and pants flapped by strong wind, creating clear physical follow-through. Body shifts from slight lean to upright stance, then weight moves to toes. Lighting remains natural daylight. Backlight creates soft rim light on shoulders and facial outline. Camera slowly tilts up and gently pushes forward from chest level. Ocean waves expand spatial depth.
shot5: Shot 5: Hard cut explosion from previous shot, wide eye-level slightly overhead perspective. Cliff edge, platform, lower canyon, and distant sea all visible. Subject decisively lunges forward from center frame. Moment toes leave platform marks climax of action. Body dives into air, jacket violently pulled back by airflow. Rope trails behind, forming rapid arc. Foreground platform contrasts sharply with background canyon, creating strong depth. Camera pauses briefly, then rapidly tilts down to follow. Howling wind surges at moment of departure.
shot6: Shot 6: Continuous motion cut from previous shot, overhead follow shot. Camera descends along falling trajectory. Subject plummets rapidly toward forest canyon. Sea and cliffs rush past on both sides. Composition keeps subject and rope centered. Rope transitions from slack to sudden tautness. At taut moment, body jerks upward. Full arc drawn cleanly through air. Fabric and pants show sequential fluttering due to speed changes. Lighting maintains consistent natural quality. Camera decelerates, accurately matching transition from weightlessness to rebound.
shot7: Shot 7: Hard cut to medium lateral tracking shot. Subject suspended mid-air, arms spread wide. Facial expression shifts from clenched teeth to relief. Sea reflections and mountain shadows streak horizontally behind. Occasionally, slightly out-of-focus rope passes through foreground. Background retains moderate motion blur to enhance sense of speed. Composition places subject slightly right, leaving space on left to indicate swing direction. Camera performs stable lateral move with slight forward wrap. Wind remains strong but less sharp. Ocean waves become more clearly present, anchoring space. Arm-opening motion synchronizes with Sense of liberation clearly conveyed.
shot8: Shot 8: Fade-in pull-out closure from previous shot, wide overhead combined with slow retreat. Subject hangs suspended between mountains and sea after rebound slows. Rope gently sways. Cliff platform, forest canyon, distant sea, and ridgeline fully framed. Foreground, midground, and background layers clearly defined. Subject once again reduced to tiny dot within grand landscape, creating emotional resolution and lingering resonance. Overall tone remains neutral with natural lighting. Soft brightness at sky edge provides quiet rim light. Camera continues pulling back and slightly lifting, allowing vast space to gradually engulf human scale. Film ends in majestic yet calm suspension high above.
